Arjun P: Heads up 1: rolled a lightweight response-prefetch cache and microbatch reordering in canary (5%). Seeing ~15% p50 and ~28% p95 improvement on medium-chat workloads. GPU tokens/sec up ~12%.

Sam K: nice! is reordering the same as the small-batcher tweak we tested? any impact on prompt ordering / determinism?

Arjun P: similar idea but applied at the request queue level with a deterministic key-based sharding so ordering per conversation is preserved. Reordering only groups compatible short requests for better GPU packing.

Nina M: what flags and how do we opt tenants out? want CS to know.

Arjun P: flags: `runtime.batch.reorder=true` and `runtime.cache.prefetch_size=3`. Per-tenant override available: POST to /tenant/{id}/overrides with `runtime.batch.reorder=false`.

deploy-bot: Canary deploy completed: runtime-canary v2025.11.8. No 5xx spikes.

Sam K: did we run evals for hallucination / score drift?

Arjun P: ran our smoke eval and top-10 customer prompt checks; no drift detected. CI added a quick logprob delta check before promoting flag.

Nina M: I'll add the new metrics to the runtime dashboard: `batch.reorder_efficiency`, `cache.prefetch_util`, `model.tokens_per_gpu_s`. Also pinging CS with opt-out instructions.

Arjun P: plan to promote to 25% in 3h if metrics hold. Will post follow-ups. :rocket:
